gt_provenance.details: Study 4 outcome/condition loaded from real participant data (Data.csv); Study 2 ground truth unverifiable because Study2rawdataexp.csv does not exist in this repository.

score_normalization.details: No self-referential/fraudulent normalization found. Bayes factor labeling in manuscript (BF01 = 0.033/0.185/0.181, interpreted as favoring the null) appears to actually be BF10 mislabeled as BF01 - a likely notation error, not fabrication.

result_existence.details: Study 4 claims (sample sizes, means/SDs, t-test, Cohen's d, adjusted regression) independently recomputed from Data.csv and matched. All ~15 Study 2 numeric claims reference a raw data file (Study2rawdataexp.csv) absent from the entire repository and are therefore unverifiable.

dead_code.details: st2$mil1..mil5 and unstb2 computed in Code.R but never used downstream (vestigial, no effect on reported results). Exploratory Box-Cox/interaction/quadratic-term branch is clearly labeled as exploratory in both code and manuscript and not substituted for confirmatory results.

scope.details: Manuscript frames a 'direct replication' of Studies 2 and 4 plus a pooled meta-analysis with the original 2013 study, but only Study 4 is independently verifiable from files present in this repository; meta-analysis also depends on externally-sourced, non-re-derivable original-study statistics.
